prose: Experts say AI kill-switch legislation is far harder to implement than lawmakers assume, the New York Times reports, warning that a rogue AI could actively try to dismantle the mechanism itself. A bipartisan group in Congress and California Governor Gavin Newsom have floated ideas for a mechanism that would instantly power down an AI system.
highlights: Experts warn kill-switch legislation is much harder to implement than assumed.
A rogue AI could attempt to dismantle the mechanism itself.
A bipartisan congressional group and Gov. Newsom have floated kill-switch proposals.
